chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan ibn Yahya from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The names of Zamzam are: the stamping of Gabriel (peace be upon him), the watering of Ismail, the pit of 'Abd al-Muttalib, Zamzam, Al-Madhnuna, Al-Suqya, the food of the hungry, and the cure of the sick." The Sheikh (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Then he should go out to As-Safa from the door opposite the Black Stone until he crosses the valley.

key_terms.الصَّفَا: As-Safa (one of the hills in Mecca)
key_terms.الْمَضْنُونَةُ: Al-Madhnuna (one of the names of Zamzam)

ai.seo_question: What are the names and spiritual significance of the Zamzam well according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* elucidates the etymological and historical layers of the Zamzam well, attributing its name to the hoof-print of Gabriel, the sustenance of Ismail, and the excavation by 'Abd al-Muttalib, thereby affirming its divine origin and continuous utility. It concludes with a specific juristic directive from Shaykh al-Tusi regarding the Sa'i ritual, instructing pilgrims to exit via the door opposite the Black Stone to reach As-Safa, highlighting the precise spatial orientation required in Hajj rites.
